newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan August industrial output up 0.09 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan August industrial output up 0.09 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan's industrial output in August rose 0.09 percent from August 1995, the economics ministry said on Friday.
August industrial output was down 0.97 percent from July, the ministry said.
The manufacturing index, including metals, machinery, information electronics, chemical and consumer products, rose 2.33 percent in August rrom the same month a year ago.
Real estate and construction industry output plunged 41.52 percent from a year earlier. Mining industry output fell 22.37 percent compared with a year ago.
